targets.title: Trader WITH vs WITHOUT Stop Loss 😂 #shorts
targets.author: Platinum Research
targets.text:
Trader with stop loss vs trader without stop loss. Only traders will understand. 😂

A stop loss is the simplest risk management tool. You take a small, planned loss and keep your capital for the next trade. Without one, "it will come back" can turn a small loss into a big one.

👍 Like, share and subscribe if this was relatable.
💬 Comment below: have you ever skipped your stop loss?

targets.title: ✦INTRADAY TRADER✦ 1% a day sounds small. Do the yearly math before you believe it 👇
targets.author: Intraday trader
targets.text:
Compounding math for beginners: why 1% a day for a year comes to about 12x your money, and why "daily 1%" promises are often marketing, not math.

1% a day sounds modest, but compounding over about 250 trading days turns it into roughly 12x your money. That same math is why "daily 1%" promises look so attractive. Compounding works in your favour only when every day is consistent and losses stay small. One oversized loss can wipe out weeks of gains. This video is for every intraday trader who wants to check the numbers before believing a promise.

targets.title: This Trading Strategy Should Have Died in 2019. It Didn't.
targets.author: Algovibes
targets.text:
A Journal of Finance paper says one commodity signal, basis-momentum, earned a Sharpe ratio close to 1 across about 20 commodities. A member of my community asked the obvious question: the paper came out in 2019, so does it still work now that everybody has read it? I rebuilt it on the official daily settlement price of every single futures contract in 19 commodities from 2011 to November 2026, with costs on every trade and every roll, and tested it against 1,000 random versions. One of the two signals survived. The other one didn't.
